# EUROpolis

> Border insurance for foreign-registered vehicles travelling to European Union countries. EUROpolis is the website of insurance agent Rižova Ludmila in Latvia, presenting services involving ERGO Insurance SE Latvijas filiāle.

The product described on this website is border motor third-party liability insurance (Robežpolise / OCTA). It is distinct from an international Green Card and from own-damage insurance. Eligibility, territorial scope, start date, term and exclusions must be confirmed for the specific policy and route using the product information and insurer's terms.

Contact: Rižova Ludmila; telephone +371-207-702-44; email ludmila.rizova@ergo.lv.
Working hours are fixed to Europe/Minsk (UTC+03:00): Monday–Thursday 09:00–17:30, Friday 09:00–16:30; Saturday and Sunday closed. The Contacts pages also show this schedule in the visitor's browser time zone.

## Main pages

- [Insurance, calculator and application](https://euro-polis.com/en): Product overview, estimated price, application process and common questions.
- [About the insurance agent](https://euro-polis.com/en/about): Agent identity and published insurer information.
- [Contacts and opening hours](https://euro-polis.com/en/contacts): Current contact details and time-zone-aware schedule.
- [Product information](https://euro-polis.com/en/product-info): Scope of cover, exclusions and product documents.
- [Terms and conditions](https://euro-polis.com/en/rules): Website service and application terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://euro-polis.com/en/privacy): Personal-data processing information.
- [Cookie Policy](https://euro-polis.com/en/cookiepolicy): Information about cookies.
